lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively uniform with slight compression in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: The 4th and 5th lines from the anterior merge at the dorsal junction; no other bifurcations visible.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line is a short segment; posterior lines 12 and 13 terminate before reaching the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated white spots visible on the upper-mid region of the posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two haunch spots align on a near-vertical axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Symmetric lyrate curvature; 1st-stage lateral divergence, 2nd-stage medial convergence, 3rd-stage vertical apical orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Terminal tip distance is approximately 4.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping occupies approximately the top 10% of the visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Vivid white horizontal chevron between the eyes and a white dorsal mane running the length of the spine.
